name: HeroSpatialStage
summary: Deep Espresso hero framed with approved WarmHorizonWash lighting, pairing Geist 300 display copy with immediate stylized product chrome.
usageGuidelines: Lead with a single crisp display headline (<= 10 words) and one primary CTA.
Render meaningful stylized product proof immediately at 0% scroll.
responsiveBehavior: Two-column split above 768px; stacks headline -> CTAs -> full-width product frame on phones.
reducedMotionFallback: Static-first layout renders complete headline, CTAs, and stylized product frame immediately at 0ms with zero entrance opacity traps.
accessibilityNotes: Single <h1> per standalone page (or headingLevel='h3' when embedded)
Ivory text on Deep Espresso clears 17.44:1 AAA
exampleCode:
import { HeroSpatialStage } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<HeroSpatialStage
  headline="One measured language for every Hahlex surface."
  lead="Shared foundations, photo-free marketing craft, and accessible product primitives."
  primaryCtaLabel="Explore Foundations"
/>

name: HeroTypographicPoster
summary: Editorial Cream monumental Geist 300 statement separated by a 1px hairline from an asymmetric CTA and tabular proof metric bar.
usageGuidelines: Ideal for manifesto pages, documentation launches, or feature deep-dives where typography leads.
responsiveBehavior: Fluid clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) display scale; bottom rule splits cleanly into stacked lead and metric grid.
reducedMotionFallback: Zero motion dependencies; typography and tabular metrics paint statically on initial load.
accessibilityNotes: Uses --fg-accent so numerals clear WCAG AA/AAA in both light and dark modes
exampleCode:
import { HeroTypographicPoster } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<HeroTypographicPoster headline="Design systems should enforce craft." lead="One DTCG source." ctaLabel="Read Spec" />

name: EditorialEssaySplit
summary: Warm Cream 60/40 magazine spread combining capped 65ch prose, a framed Warm Sand blockquote, and a ConcentricArcCanvas plate.
usageGuidelines: Break visual pacing between dark product stages using warm editorial breathing room.
responsiveBehavior: Stacks narrative prose above the geometric plate on narrow viewports.
reducedMotionFallback: ConcentricArcCanvas renders a static DPR-calibrated geometric plate with zero animation loop.
exampleCode:
import { EditorialEssaySplit } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<EditorialEssaySplit heading="Warm editorial authority" body="..." quote="..." quoteAttribution="Millar" />

name: BentoNarrativeMosaic
summary: Asymmetric multi-scale mosaic combining UnifiedOrbitDiagram, MetricPlateCard, AssistantThreadPreview, and dark DotMatrixField.
usageGuidelines: Replaces monotonous equal 3-column icon-in-box card grids with varied scale and visual grammar.
responsiveBehavior: Two asymmetric columns on desktop collapse gracefully to single column on phones.
reducedMotionFallback: All four asymmetric tiles render complete diagrams and data statically with zero scroll-reveal gating.
accessibilityNotes: Every SVG diagram carries descriptive aria-label
exampleCode:
import { BentoNarrativeMosaic } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<BentoNarrativeMosaic heading="Built for teams and AI agents" lead="One registry." />

name: ProductStageShowcase
summary: Interactive Deep Espresso stage with APG-compliant pill tabs switching live stylized Hahlex UI frames immediately on click or arrow keys.
usageGuidelines: Use instead of repetitive scroll-scrubbed fake chat windows.
responsiveBehavior: Tab pills flex-wrap cleanly; product frame remains readable at full width on mobile.
reducedMotionFallback: Tab switches swap live stylized views immediately with zero transition delay or auto-cycling.
accessibilityNotes: Full WAI-ARIA APG tablist with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End, roving tabindex, aria-controls, and aria-labelledby

name: WorkflowLoopSection
summary: Interactive 6-step closed-loop governance schematic on deepest espresso with collision-free step cells.
usageGuidelines: Use strictly when step sequence carries real operational meaning.
responsiveBehavior: Auto-fits from 3x2 / 6-up grid down to vertical mobile step rail without hiding any labels.
reducedMotionFallback: All 6 workflow stages display legibly without hover or scroll triggers; selection updates immediately.
accessibilityNotes: Ordered <ol> semantics with aria-pressed active step buttons

name: ArchitectureGridSection
summary: Visible-rule CoordinateGridSurface showcasing 4 technical pillars with monospaced spec identifiers.
usageGuidelines: Reserve monospaced tags strictly for genuine technical standard codes (DTCG, WCAG, MCP).
responsiveBehavior: 2x2 coordinate grid collapses into a cleanly divided vertical column below 640px.
reducedMotionFallback: Pure static architectural grid with crisp 1px hairlines and corner registration crosshairs.
accessibilityNotes: High-contrast fg-accent spec codes on white/cream and dark surfaces

name: MetricMirrorSection
summary: Three alternating Warm Sand & Espresso MetricPlateCards paired with a BeforeAfterLedger evidence table.
usageGuidelines: Only display real measured benchmarks or explicitly labeled illustrative metrics.
responsiveBehavior: Metric plates auto-fit cleanly across 1/2/3 columns.
reducedMotionFallback: Metrics display immediately at final values with zero number-counting animation delay.
accessibilityNotes: tabular-nums alignment on all numeric figures

name: NativeAccordionFaq
summary: Zero-JS semantic <details>/<summary> FAQ accordion in Warm Sand with high-contrast keyboard focus.
usageGuidelines: Keep answers crisp (2-3 sentences max) and match page language strictly.
responsiveBehavior: Centered 880px reading measure adapts cleanly down to 320px.
reducedMotionFallback: Native HTML <details> disclosure toggles instantaneously without height-animation jank.
accessibilityNotes: Native HTML disclosure works with keyboard and screen readers without custom ARIA hacks

name: ClosingConversionBand & MillarSiteFooter
summary: PaperTearDivider opening into a calm Deep Espresso conversion band, paired with a semantically isolated top-level <footer> outside <main>.
usageGuidelines: Always place MillarSiteFooter as a sibling AFTER </main> so assistive technology recognizes the contentinfo landmark.
responsiveBehavior: Footer wraps lockup and metadata neatly on phones.
reducedMotionFallback: Static SVG paper tear and Deep Espresso conversion band require zero motion.
